name: 64079 · Platte City, MO
findings: ZIP 64079 (Platte City) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64079 (Platte City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64079 (Platte City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
